title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 67: Electronic devices (Set 1)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Electronic devices (Set 1) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

vocabTable.example: Complete the words, using the hints given. I use my 1.1 to listen to songs while doing my homework. The 1.2 helps us create models for our school science projects. My mom uses the 1.3 to clean the carpet every Saturday morning. We use the 1.4 to record videos of family events like birthdays and holidays.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Electronic devices (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Complete the conversation, using the following words. Tom: Hey, Sarah! Is that the 14.1 you've recently bought? Sarah: That's right! It’s very handy! Tom: That’s cool! Is it made of 14.2 ? Sarah: Yes, most of it. It’s light and easy to carry around. It also has many colors to choose. Tom: I see. Do you know if any parts are made from other materials? Sarah: Actually, the buttons are made from 14.3 . It makes them strong and durable. Tom: That’s interesting. What about the wires inside? Sarah: The wires inside are made from 14.4  because it is conductive. Tom: I never realized how many materials are used in these devices!

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Electronic devices (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Drag and drop to complete the passage.  In the manufacturing of electronic devices, various materials are used for different parts. For example, 15.1 is commonly used to make the frame of the device. It is strong and helps the device stay sturdy. Some parts, like buttons and seals, are made from 15.2 because it is flexible and provides a soft touch. To create these parts, manufacturers 15.3 the material into different shapes. This process ensures the details fit perfectly in the device. Once all parts are made, workers 15.4 the device by joining the separate pieces together. After that, the device is tested to make sure everything works well. This combination of materials and processes ensures that electronic devices are both functional and durable.
